cues.en: Agafia Lykov is one of Russia's old believers, an ultra-orthodox sect of Christianity that still exists in small communities around the world today. Fearing oppression and death at the hands of Stalin, Agafia's father Karp fled with his family into the Sian Mountains of Siberia in 1936. Agafia was born into this harsh wilderness in 1944. The Lykov family lived undisturbed for 40 years,
cues.zh: Agafia Lykov 是俄罗斯旧信徒之一，这是一个基督教极端正统派别，如今仍存在于世界各地的小社区中。因害怕遭Stalin压迫和杀害，Agafia的父亲Karp于1936年带着家人逃入西伯利亚的Sian山脉。Agafia于1944年出生在这片严酷的荒野中。Lykov一家不受打扰地生活了40年，

cues.en: building a life in an environment where the winter temperatures commonly dip to minus 30. The summer growing season is short and bears and wolves roam in abundance. However, food was always scarce and in 1961 Agafia's mother, Akalina, starved herself to death so that her children would have enough food to eat. The area they settled in is currently over 160 miles from the nearest town. In summer,
cues.zh: 在这样的环境里建立生活，冬季气温常降到零下30度。夏季生长季很短，熊和狼大量出没。然而食物一直短缺，1961年，Agafia的母亲Akalina为了让孩子们有足够的食物吃，把自己饿死了。他们定居的地方现在距离最近的城镇超过160英里。夏天，

cues.en: It's possible to reach the Lykov's cabin by a seven-day canoe trip. In winter, while we had heard rumors of a treacherous snowmobile route, it is virtually inaccessible by anything other than helicopter. In 1978, a team of Russian geologists spotted the Lykov's hillside farm from their helicopter. They later hiked in to meet them. It was the first contact with outsiders that the Lykovs had in over 40 years, and it marked the end of their isolation.
cues.zh: 乘独木舟七天可以到达 Lykov 的小屋。冬天，我们虽听说过一条凶险的雪地摩托路线，但除了直升机，这里几乎无法进入。1978年，一队俄罗斯地质学家乘直升机发现了 Lykov 一家位于山坡上的农庄。后来他们徒步进去与他们见面。这是 Lykov 一家40多年来第一次与外界接触，也标志着他们与世隔绝的结束。

cues.en: Since that initial visit, the Lycops have become famous in Russia as the family of Siberian hermits who didn't know that World War II took place. They also suffered unspeakable tragedy when the three elder children all died within weeks of each other, presumably from pneumonia contracted from a visit by the geologists. Agafia's father Karp later died in 1988, 27 years to the day after his wife passed away. Despite sporadic visitors over the years,
cues.zh: 自那次初次探访后，Lykov 一家在俄罗斯出了名，被称为不知道二战发生过的西伯利亚隐士家庭。他们还遭受了难以言说的悲剧：三个年长的孩子几周内相继去世，据推测是因地质学家到访而感染了肺炎。Agafia 的父亲 Karp 后来于1988年去世，正好是他妻子离世27年后的同一天。尽管多年来偶有访客，

cues.en: Agafia lived alone until 1997, when one of the geologists, a man named Ureyfus Setov, moved to a cabin down the hill from her. So now, 35 years after their first contact, Agafia is the only Lykov left, living the same way she has since she was born, and the only way she knows how, off the land, in one of the most inhospitable environments on Earth. Our journey to meet Agafia began with a 10-hour red-eye flight from New York to Moscow.
cues.zh: Agafia 一直独自生活，直到1997年，一位名叫 Ureyfus Setov 的地质学家搬到了她山下的小屋。于是现在，在他们首次接触35年后，Agafia 是唯一还在世的 Lykov，仍按她自出生以来的方式生活，也是她唯一懂得的方式——靠土地为生，身处地球上最不宜居的环境之一。我们与 Agafia 见面的旅程，始于从纽约飞往莫斯科的10小时红眼航班。

cues.zh: 尽管外部世界以访客、政府、媒体和坠落火箭残骸等形式偶尔闯入，阿加菲娅的日常生活基本没有改变。她的持续生存证明，人类可以在如此艰难的环境中独自生活。西伯利亚荒野曾经住着许多旧信徒。当我们飞越广袤空旷的泰加林时，不难想象，在某个地方……

cues.en: there may well be more people like Agafia.
cues.zh: 很可能还有更多像 Agafia 这样的人。
